name: Special City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Azusa is hereby called to be held Monday, March 18, 2013 at 08:30 a.m. at 729 N. Azusa Ave., Azusa, California.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
* Call to Order
* Pledge to the Flag
* National Anthem
* Invocation - Pastor Woody Calvary of Praise Chapel of Azusa.
B.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
Limited to items listed on this Special Meeting Notice.
C.
RESOLUTION DECLARING ELECTION RESULTS
1.
RESOLUTION RECITING THE FACTS OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD IN THE CITY OF AZUSA ON MARCH 5, 2013, DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY THE PROVISIONS OF LAW.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Waive further reading and adopt Resolution No. 13-C13.
C-1 Election Results Staff Report
C-1 Election Results Staff Report
C-1 Resolution Election Results
C-1 Exhibit A, Election Results
D.
OATH OF OFFICE
1.
Oath of Office to be administered to newly elected officials: CITY CLERK - Jeffrey Lawrence Cornejo, Jr.;
CITY TREASURER - Arthur M. Vasquez;
COUNCILMEMBER - Edward John Alvarez;
COUNCILMEMBER - Robert Gonzales;
MAYOR - Joseph Romero Rocha.
E.
SELECTION OF A MAYOR PRO-TEM.
1.
Selection of Mayor Pro-tem.
E-1 Selection Mayor Pro-tem
E-1 Attachment Selction Mayor Pro-tem, Reso 10-C20
F.
RECOGNITION OF OUTGOING ELECTED OFFICALS.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
